item.title: meee2 v0.4.1-rc1
item.description:
## What's Changed * [codex] Publish board packages under meee1 scope by @rsgok in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/5 * Publish board packages to npm by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/6 * Redesign WebUI shell — Claude Code-inspired, truly transparent titlebar by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/7 * WIP merge: comm-kit split, WebUI shell, TUI removal, perf + IME fixes by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/8 * fix(ClaudeDesktopMetadataReader): pick unarchived wrapper when cliSessionId collides by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/9 * feat(TranscriptView): three-level verbosity (normal / thinking / verbose) by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/10 * fix(BoardWebWindowController): bypass HTTP cache on initial load + reload by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/11 * feat(TranscriptView): live in-flight indicator + tool-call rollup by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/12 * feat(Dock): move transcript verbosity pill from search bar to ChatComposer by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/13 * fix(inject): surface "queued_until_next_turn" delivery hint for Desktop sessions by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/14 * feat(diagnostics): user-visible log + status-bar diag entries by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/16 * feat(ClaudeDesktopInputStream): infrastructure for explicit-push to Desktop sessions by @hawkelethan9 in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/15
## New Contributors * @hawkelethan9 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/pull/6
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tianqixinxi/meee2/compare/0.3.0...v0.4.1-rc1
